def solve_cvrp(instance):

    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    customers = set(customer_ids)

    # Defensive: if any customers missing demands, keep incumbent behavior.
    if not customers:
        return []

    # -------- Helpers --------
    def route_load(rt):
        s = 0
        for n in rt:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def route_cost(rt):
        if not rt:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][rt[0]] + matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(rt) - 1):
            c += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for rt in routes:
            s += route_cost(rt)
        return s

    def try_2opt_intra(rt):
        # deterministic first-improvement
        best_improved = True
        while best_improved:
            best_improved = False
            n = len(rt)
            if n < 4:
                return rt
            base = matrix[depot][rt[0]] + matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
            for i in range(n - 1):
                base += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
            # scan
            for i in range(n - 1):
                a = rt[i]
                b = rt[i + 1]
                for j in range(i + 2, n - 1):
                    c = rt[j]
                    d = rt[j + 1]
                    # delta if reverse segment (i+1..j)
                    old = matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d]
                    new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                    if new < old:
                        # apply
                        rt[i + 1:j + 1] = list(reversed(rt[i + 1:j + 1]))
                        best_improved = True
                        break
                if best_improved:
                    break
        return rt

    def try_relocate_inter(routes):
        # deterministic best-improving relocate (single node), feasibility-only + improvement
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        best_delta = 0
        best_move = None  # (r_from, pos, r_to)
        cur_cost = total_cost(routes)

        for rf_idx, rf in enumerate(routes):

                continue

                node = rf[pos]
                nd = demands[node]
                for rt_idx, rt in enumerate(routes):
                    if rt_idx == rf_idx:
                        continue
                    if loads[rt_idx] + nd > capacity:
                        continue
                    # compute delta of moving node rf[pos] to best position in rt as insertion anywhere
                    # We'll evaluate best insertion position for deterministic choice.
                    # Evaluate removal delta from rf
                    if pos == 0:
                        rem_old = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][rf[pos + 1]]
                        rem_new = matrix[depot][rf[pos + 1]]
                    elif pos == len(rf) - 1:
                        rem_old = matrix[rf[pos - 1]][node] + matrix[node][depot]
                        rem_new = matrix[rf[pos - 1]][depot]
                    else:
                        rem_old = matrix[rf[pos - 1]][node] + matrix[node][rf[pos + 1]]
                        rem_new = matrix[rf[pos - 1]][rf[pos + 1]]

def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    customer_ids = instance["customer_ids"]
    customers = set(customer_ids)

    # Defensive: if any customers missing demands, keep incumbent behavior.
    if not customers:
        return []

    # -------- Helpers --------
    def route_load(rt):
        s = 0
        for n in rt:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def route_cost(rt):
        if not rt:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][rt[0]] + matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(rt) - 1):
            c += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for rt in routes:
            s += route_cost(rt)
        return s

    def try_2opt_intra(rt):
        # deterministic first-improvement
        best_improved = True
        while best_improved:
            best_improved = False
            n = len(rt)
            if n < 4:
                return rt
            base = matrix[depot][rt[0]] + matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
            for i in range(n - 1):
                base += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
            # scan
            for i in range(n - 1):
                a = rt[i]
                b = rt[i + 1]
                for j in range(i + 2, n - 1):
                    c = rt[j]
                    d = rt[j + 1]
                    # delta if reverse segment (i+1..j)
                    old = matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d]
                    new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                    if new < old:
                        # apply
                        rt[i + 1:j + 1] = list(reversed(rt[i + 1:j + 1]))
                        best_improved = True
                        break
                if best_improved:
                    break
        return rt

    def try_relocate_inter(routes):
        # deterministic best-improving relocate (single node), feasibility-only + improvement
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        best_delta = 0
        best_move = None  # (r_from, pos, r_to)
        cur_cost = total_cost(routes)

        # Precompute route boundary costs contributions for speed
        for rf_idx, rf in enumerate(routes):
            if not rf:
                continue
            for pos in range(len(rf)):
                node = rf[pos]
                nd = demands[node]
                for rt_idx, rt in enumerate(routes):
